Next: the three sides.
Shopper flow, driver flow, retailer flow. One artboard series each, once the name and look are settled.
Mark v2 is adapted from Hugeicons Refresh01 (MIT licence): stroke 2.4 instead of 1.5, arrow shortened, opening widened so it reads as a c.

Name check, Sept 2026: no exact COMEBACK mark found live in classes 35, 39 or 42 by web search, but comeback.com, .co and .app are taken and a loyalty-software company trades as ComeBack App. Needs a paid clearance search before spending on it.
Two alternates, sketched only. Comeback is the recommendation. Say the word and either of these gets built out instead.
